scenes.title: Share and listen to the channel

vo.text: The file travels through air as radio signals.
vo.speak: The file travels through air as radio signals.

vo.text: First, your device divides the data into packets.
vo.speak: First, your device divides the data into packets.

vo.text: Each packet includes addressing and error-checking information.
vo.speak: Each packet includes addressing and error-checking information.

vo.text: The radio maps groups of bits onto changes in a carrier wave.
vo.speak: The radio maps groups of bits onto changes in a carrier wave.

vo.text: Wi-Fi also splits the data across many closely spaced subcarriers, using a method called OFDM.
vo.speak: Wi-Fi also splits the data across many closely spaced subcarriers, using a method called OFDM.

vo.text: These radio signals share the available channel with other nearby devices.
vo.speak: These radio signals share the available channel with other nearby devices.

vo.text: A device listens before transmitting and adjusts when the channel is busy.
vo.speak: A device listens before transmitting and adjusts when the channel is busy.

vo.text: The receiver decodes the subcarriers, checks the packets, and requests retransmission if needed.
vo.speak: The receiver decodes the subcarriers, checks the packets, and requests retransmission if needed.

vo.text: Correct packets are reassembled into the original photo.
vo.speak: Correct packets are reassembled into the original photo.

vo.text: Wi-Fi turns data into carefully organized radio waves, then turns those waves back into data.
vo.speak: Wi-Fi turns data into carefully organized radio waves, then turns those waves back into data.
